verdict.rationale: Missive's own marketing says teams can "collaborate behind the scenes — without changing your workflow," and a community user notes they can collaborate directly in a thread rather than adding everyone to a box. Together these imply internal discussion attached to conversations, but no evidence explicitly describes comments or @mentions beside an email message. Team chat (docs-8) and collaborative drafting (docs-7) are related features rather than this capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of internal comments on email threads, @mention support, and hands-on corroboration of side-thread discussion.
